title: Mark your calendars!! 👀 #broadway #theatre #musicaltheatre #plays #ar...
transcript: Attention theatre fans, on Labor Day, Monday, September 7th, I will be hosting a very special live stream right here on my channel to honor the 11th Annual Weinberg Awards® The Weinberg Awards® are, of course, a very real and legitimate awards body. They've been celebrating excellence in live theatre since 2016, and they are distributed by By the esteemed Weinberg Awards® Committee, of which I just happened to be the chairman and sole member. And on this live stream, we will be celebrating excellence in the 2025-2026 Theatre season. You might be wondering, why is this happening in September instead of in the spring and summer when the rest of the awards happen? Well, per tradition, the Weinberg Awards® season begins in September and ends in August to better reflect the real life programming rhythm of New York City theatre. When you think about it, doing it this way makes a lot more sense. And that is why we are the best award show. So, like I said, come by for this live stream on Monday, September 7th at 7PM Eastern. We're gonna go through the nominees and winners, and in between each category, maybe we'll take a break for some questions. Maybe we'll talk about theater in general, maybe look forward to the theater season ahead. It's gonna be a really fun time. And do me a favor, if you think you can make it, let me know in the comments so I can kinda get a rough head count.
